companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Careers-page URLs (e.g. https://boards.greenhouse.io/stripe, https://jobs.lever.co/spotify, https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/openai, https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite), 'ats:slug' pairs (greenhouse:stripe), or a bare slug (stripe), which is tried on every supported ATS except Workday (Workday needs the URL).

titleKeywords.title: Title keywords
titleKeywords.description: Keep jobs whose title contains any of these (case-insensitive). Empty keeps all.

locationKeywords.title: Location keywords
locationKeywords.description: Keep jobs whose location contains any of these (case-insensitive). Empty keeps all.

postedAfter.title: Posted or updated on or after
postedAfter.description: ISO date. Use it for daily 'new jobs' monitoring.

includeDescription.title: Include description text
includeDescription.description: Adds the plain-text job description to each item.

maxJobsPerCompany.title: Max jobs per company
maxJobsPerCompany.description: Upper limit per company after filtering.
